text:
Maya (Finance): AuroraCloud invoice AC-3310 arrived referencing PO '3310-RED' but our system has PO 3310 for a different vendor. Total $2,150. No approver route. tagging @Tom (AP).

invoices-bot: Auto-match: NO_PO_FOUND. Reason: vendor_po_mismatch. Suggested action: vendor reissue or AP manual attach.

Tom (AP): Can you paste invoice header or upload PDF? I'll try a fuzzy match.

Maya (Finance): Header pasted:
"Vendor: AuroraCloud Ltd.
Invoice#: AC-3310
Date: 2026-12-22
Total: $2,150.00
PO Ref: 3310-RED
Remit-to: payables@auroracloud.com"
Link: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/AC-3310.pdf

Leah (Accounting): We have PO 3310 but vendor is EdgeCompute. Looks like vendor put their internal partner PO. Can't attach due to vendor mismatch.

AuroraCloud Billing: Hi Redwood — apologies. Our billing feed appended our partner PO suffix incorrectly. We also issued credit memo CM-88 on 2026-12-01 (TXN REF C-88). We can reissue without partner PO or reference your PO 9402 if that's available.

Raj (Procurement): AuroraCloud is approved and PO 9402 exists for 'support credits' under cost center infra-support. Approver mapping currently set to infra-ops. But invoice shows cost center 'eng-experiments' which has no approver.

invoices-bot: Routing error: MISSING_APPROVER for cost center 'eng-experiments'. Use /costcenter update or set to existing cost center.

Tom (AP): Temporarily changing cost center to infra-support to allow routing; will attach PO 9402 and hold payment pending credit verification.

invoices-bot: Manual attach OK. Invoice AC-3310 attached to PO 9402. Routed to infra-ops for approval. Status: Pending approval.

AuroraCloud Billing: We'll resend corrected invoice referencing PO 9402 and attach credit memo CM-88 proof. Please confirm when ready so we can clear batch.

Maya (Finance): Thanks. Tom created ticket FIN-9802 for credit reconciliation and hold. Payment blocked until credit is matched and approver signs off. @Raj please confirm approver mapping for eng-experiments so next time routing works. :pray:
